profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced in object oriented design patterns and the stages of the software development life cycle. Skilled in AWS Cloud Solutions, DevOps, AI/ML, and Back-End Programming.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Back-End Web Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Continuous Integration (CI) · Software Design

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed back-end application services to facilitate automation of program deployments with Jenkins.
• Created command line scripts to update metadata on 182 resources to fulfill CloudWatch requirements using Lambda functions.
• Collaborated via pair programming to create a form using ReactJS and Javascript, adding value to the company by saving customer solutions team time and resources to update the database for 300+ UBreakIFix stores.
positions.insights: Skills: AWS Lambda · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Information Technology Support Associate
positions.description:
• Troubleshooted software, hardware and network problems for college faculty, staff, and students.
• Communicated clearly to provide supportive customer service by translating technical terms into practical language.
• Conducted weekly performance checks on assigned printers and computers and attended monthly informational meetings.

positions.title: Global Operations & Technology Analyst
positions.description:
• Collaborated to develop time series prediction models for daily ATM volume estimation with visualizations.
• Utilized Pandas to rearrange large data sets to train machine learning algorithms in Python.
• Achieved performance of 8% mean absolute percent error on forecast models that incorporated external variables.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Python (Programming Language) · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Spanish Data Annotator
positions.description: Expanded the Spanish language database by sourcing text, audio, and media of real life and current events.

positions.title: Communications and Digital Campaign Organizer
positions.description:
• Identified ways to maximize technological tools for communications.
• Curated social media content, increasing engagement by up to three times in the first few weeks.
• Participated in city-wide campaign to expand public transit into South Phoenix and drafted press releases.
• Represented the organization at national coalition conferences and supported four of the coalition’s digital campaigns.

positions.title: Extern
positions.description:
• Supported impacted communities to resist threats from the fossil fuel industry and speed the just transition to 100% clean, renewable energy. 
• Conducted research for a campaign against opening California's public lands for oil fracking.

honors.title: GHC 20 Student Scholarship
honors.description: Selected from a strong group of applicants based on merit and purpose to attend the 2020 Virtual Grace Hopper Celebration.
honors.issuer: Issued by Grace Hopper Celebration Programs · Jun 2020

honors.title: Carmelita Manning Community Service Award
honors.description: Awarded to an undergraduate student exemplifying the spirit of public service in the Latino community.   With this award, the Pan American Association of Philadelphia hopes to challenge students to participate in the community and help nurture a sense of global social responsibility and duty.
honors.issuer: Issued by Pan American Association of Philadelphia · Apr 2020

projects.title: Lang Center Summer Social Impact Scholarship
projects.description: Awarded grant that allowed to me serve as a Digital Organizer with Promise Arizona.

projects.title: Google Explore CSResearch
projects.description:
• Collaborated on writing SQL and Python programs to filter and analyze trends in AP syslog messages.
• Investigated resource issues based on Wi-Fi mobility trends on a college campus.
• Created visualizations of findings using Plotly and presented at a poster symposium at the University of Pennsylvania.
